d: The US-Iran conflict escalates as fresh explosions hit Iran's Qeshm Island, marking the third reported strike in three days. Meanwhile, a drone attack on Iraq’s Khor Mor gas field halts production, triggering a fire and disrupting over 70 per cent of electricity supplies across Kurdistan. Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warns Washington of a ‘rain of hell’, while the IRGC threatens more devastating strikes. As Trump keeps military options open, Qatar steps up diplomatic efforts to prevent further escalation. Josh Barnes tells you more on Firstpost Live.
